description: Get the input/output schema for a published MetaModel project. Returns model names, input parameters (with types, defaults, validation), and output fields. Models marked "presentation": true are display scaffolding (3D scenes etc.) — skip them for engineering analysis. Use a token from metamodel_list_projects.

token.description: The publish token of the project (from metamodel_list_projects)

name: metamodel_get_schema
title: Read a project's inputs and outputs
